main_text.head: PRÆFATIO.
main_text.p:
e im:[?] sed indicandi sunt abusus, & contra[?] eos agendū et osten-dendum ex verbo Dei, quare iis acquiescere nefas sit, & ad ve-rum usum omnia sunt revocanda. Nec enim abusus potestatis ipsam potestatem seu auctorita-tem tollit. Egregiè insignis ille & per controversias, quas con-tra Pontificios edidit optimè de Ecclesia meritus Theologus Da-niel Chamierus de hac re disserit lib.14.de Pontif.Oecum. cap II. postquam enim respon-disset ad exceptionem Bellarmi-ni, dicentis Abiatharem Sacer-dotem à Salomone depositum
(?) 3

page.notes: The first line is partly obscured by a stain, so "e im:" and "contra" are uncertain. The reference mark "(?) 3" at the lower right is unclear. "Daniel Chamierus" is set in larger roman type, and "lib.14.de Pontif.Oecum." and "cap II." are roman. No running head or page number is printed.
